newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to rule on Thomson sale despite announcement.
newsitem.headline: EU to rule on Thomson sale despite announcement.

text.p: BRUSSELS, Dec 4 (Reuter) The European Commission is to announce later on Wednesday or Thursday that it clears the sale of Thomson SA to Lagardere and Daewoo Electronics despite the French government's decision to cancel the deal.

Although not commenting on the decision's content, the spokesman for European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said that under the EU's merger legislation the Commission was legally bound to give its verdict.

EU officials had widely expected the Commission to approve the operations. But earlier on Wednesday the French government announced it was cancelling the sale following the negative opinion of France's parliamentary privatisation commission.

The merger regulation, used by the Commission to vet large mergers and acquisitions which affect trade in the bloc, sets strict deadlines, including for withdrawing a deal formally submitted for clearance.
